sentiment.rule: Mean P(positive)-P(negative) on dated, recent, deduplicated, explicitly asset-related headlines with directional confidence >=0.8. At least2 articles and2 publishers; mean >=0.2 vetoes SHORT, <=-0.2 vetoes LONG. Neutral/conflicting evidence does not veto. Never infers high-risk events from sentiment.

rules: Separate ETH G151, BTC with ETH weights, and BTC trained forests; each has control and local-sentiment portfolios with base/stress costs.
Freeze all rules, data checksums and model hashes; no parameter search or automatic promotion.

BTC forests use only matured labels before01jun2026 and the preserved G151 hyperparameters/routes/thresholds. Corrected funding and explicit1min entry delay are adaptations; no claim of exact historical reproduction.
Historical comparison uses the same Jun-Sep2026 dates without news; those ETH periods were already explored and are not an independent holdout. Modern news is never applied to historical trades.
Prospective arms share start/end. First observation after registration must precede next-minute entry. No missing-decision backfill.
Per-symbol current Binance filters; retroactive historical application is an approximation. Modeled costs and fixedFX, no personal fee or tax reconstruction.

News is classified locally from English headlines; asset relevance is explicit keyword matching, not causal impact detection. Duplicate events with different headlines may remain. Scores are not price/profit probabilities.
Preserve all earlier experiments and state; no real orders, account keys, paid AI or model retraining during the30day prospective run.
